mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and depresses valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.5%), a further rise in unemployment signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month indicates strengthening consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has risen over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 215.0), a further increase in inflation signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, depressing valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year period.
